flags.message: Independent general-precedent retrieval was degraded: web search/open attempts returned no usable content and CourtListener MCP returned HTTP 429 on a Caetano citation lookup. The prediction is complete, but its substantial upward adjustment rests in part on the provisioned petition's characterization of intervening Wolford precedent, without independent verification or a provisioned BIO. No target-case disposition was sought or encountered; no REST fallback was used.
